acceptanceCriteria: Under a synthetic CPU load both tests either pass or the run reports an explicit budget-exhausted verdict that the tests accept as a distinct outcome; never "ended without a verdict".
The baseline/mutation budget is documented and test-overridable.
body: Suspected load flake. Observed in the V1-0414 full-gate run 2026-10-17 (attempt e9a499d1, tree ddccd4d2, main 69c6cac03, Go 1.27.2, darwin, load 30-60), gate output evidence sha256 b190b8be302c8bac1153c92130e70b79a5f24d595857715664eb0bf964693255. internal/liveverify/mutate: mutate_test.go:199 and :267 'Run: mutate: run ended without a verdict' after ~35s each; siblings in the same run report verdict=UNSUPPORTED 'baseline tests fail before mutation' at ~32s, which suggests a fixed run budget is exhausted by baseline go test under load. Package FAIL in 341.7s. Expected: the run reaches a verdict or returns an explicit timeout/UNKNOWN verdict, and the tests do not depend on host speed. Actual: no verdict.

Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 6cd4a96dee1de877f0d475586ea6bb6b036c3a5955cae1bf4945fc3ca6dc6a2a.

title: liveverify/mutate tests end without a verdict under host load (TestRunKillsAMutantAndLeavesTheRootUntouched, TestRunReportsNoMutantsForADeclarationOnlyFile)
